We need propose a retrosynthesis route with 3 reactions for target SMILES: COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1

We need to produce JSON route with type mol root, children reaction nodes each with template_id and children molecules (precursors). Need to find appropriate templates for each step.

We have many templates from search. Need to select three steps: likely disconnection of amide bond, then disconnection of N-alkyl chain (SN2), then maybe formation of aryl ether (Friedel-Crafts acylation? Actually target has methoxy on phenyl, could be from phenol via methylation (SN2 with MeI). But guidance mentions Sn2, Friedel-Crafts acylation, substitution (halogenation). So we need to propose route using those types.

We need to find template IDs that correspond to those transformations.

Search for amide bond cleavage (functional_groups_broken: amide). Already got reaction_id 647549 with retro_smarts_template that breaks amide to give carboxylic acid? Actually retro template: [O;D1;H0:2]=[C;H0;D3;+0:1](-[NH;D2;+0:8]-[c:9])-[c:3]1...>> O-[C...]. That seems amide cleavage to give acid and amine. So we can use that as step 1: break amide between phenyl amide and heterocycle.

We need template_id = reaction_id? The tool expects template_id string. Probably use reaction_id as ID. Use 647549.

Check if template matches target. Use check_smiles_reaction_template_matching.
